decision: Require the deployment-facing read-only qrexec qualification entrypoint to bind the declared service account name as well as the non-root UID, service, coordinator Qube, and exact Git SHA; reject contracts whose nonRootVerified evidence is not true before any qrexec invocation.
winner: explicit service-user + non-root contract verification at the deployment boundary

comparison.correctness: Closes a provenance gap where a structurally valid hand-supplied contract could carry the expected UID/service/SHA while omitting or altering the intended dedicated account identity or non-root verification flag.
comparison.robustness_security: Fails closed before filesystem checks and before qrexec. The kernel EUID gate remains authoritative for runtime capability; the service-user binding independently verifies deployment configuration provenance.
comparison.latency: Local string/boolean comparisons only; no qrexec round trip or cryptographic operation added.
comparison.resource_use: No daemon, watcher, database, WAL, persistent state, or MissionQueue mutation.
comparison.regression_risk: Narrow deployment-contract change with focused negative tests; lower-level transport and MissionQueue semantics remain unchanged.
comparison.qa: Added fail-before-qrexec tests for service-user mismatch and nonRootVerified tampering, retaining existing service/coordinator/UID/SHA mismatch coverage.

rejected.reason: Strong for runtime capability but incomplete for deployment provenance and dedicated account configuration drift.

rejected.approach: Trust serviceUser metadata without an expected value
rejected.reason: Checks presence but cannot detect configuration drift or substitution.
Adds lifecycle, IPC, resource, and regression surface without improving the pre-invocation contract enough to justify it.

lessons: Runtime EUID verification and deployment configuration provenance are complementary controls, not substitutes.
Externally supplied qualification evidence must be revalidated field-by-field; builder invariants alone are insufficient at trust boundaries.
Keep Phase-1 read-only qualification fail-closed and non-mutating until real Qubes policy evidence is execution-derived.
